notion-note-taker.0: If your team already lives in Notion, a Notion note taker sounds ideal: your meeting notes land next to your docs, tasks and wikis, with no new tool to buy. And for many teams the Notion note taker is ideal. Others find a few limits matter more than the convenience.
notion-note-taker.1: What follows is based on Notion's own pricing page and help center, checked in October 2026: how it works, what it costs, and where it stops.
notion-note-taker.2: Notion's AI note taker is a feature called AI Meeting Notes. From the Notion desktop app, it transcribes a meeting, then writes a summary and action items into the Notion page where you started it. In Notion's words, it automates "your meeting notes and follow-ups, no bot needed."
notion-note-taker.4: Starting it takes 3 steps: type `/meet` on a page in the Notion desktop app, click **Start transcribing** when the meeting begins, and click **Stop** when it ends. A summary then appears automatically.
notion-note-taker.7: No, not for ongoing use. Notion's AI note taker is included on the Business and Enterprise plans, while the Free and Plus plans get a "limited trial" of AI Meeting Notes, along with a trial of Notion AI.
notion-note-taker.8: Yearly billing with Notion saves up to 20%. On Plus today? Moving to Business for meeting notes doubles your per-member cost from $10 to $20.
notion-note-taker.9: A 10-person team pays $2,400 a year for Notion Business, at $20 per member per month. That price also covers the full Notion workspace and Notion AI, so compare it against the tools it replaces, not just a note taker.
notion-note-taker.10: Billing is per workspace member, not per person who records meetings. Only a few people take notes? A dedicated note taker can cost less.
notion-note-taker.12: That matters for US teams with global customers. If your calls include Hindi, or switch between Hindi and English, Notion is not the right fit today, whereas Lynkk (our product) supports 17 languages including Hindi, with a Hinglish setting for mid-sentence switching.
notion-note-taker.15: Both Notion AI Meeting Notes and Granola capture meetings without a bot. Granola is a dedicated note app ($14 per user per month for Business) with Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android apps, whereas Notion's note taker is a feature inside a full workspace ($20 per member per month).
notion-note-taker.16: Already running on Notion Business? Notion makes sense. Want a standalone note app? Go with Granola. See [Granola AI alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/granola-ai-alternatives) for more.
notion-note-taker.20: Want a general method that works with any tool? See our guide to [meeting preparation](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-preparation).
notion-note-taker.21: Notion's note taker falls short in 4 areas. Every meeting needs the desktop app, and use is capped at 10 hours a day; speakers are labeled only in English, and nothing preps you before calls or files tickets after them.
notion-note-taker.22: Action is the bigger gap for many teams. The notes are good, but turning decisions into Jira tickets or chasing owners still takes manual work. Notion tasks help if your team plans in Notion; teams planning in Jira need another step.
notion-note-taker.23: If you want meeting notes that do more than sit in a page, Lynkk (our product) is built for the work around the meeting. Right now Lynkk works alongside Notion rather than inside it, since Notion is listed as a coming-soon Lynkk integration.
notion-note-taker.24: Lynkk's free plan covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each, and Pro costs $15 a month. Team workflows? See [how product teams turn meeting minutes into Jira issues](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-minutes-to-jira).
notion-note-taker.26: The Notion note taker is worth it if your team already pays for Notion Business, meets mostly in English, and keeps project work in Notion. Less so if you would upgrade from Plus only for meeting notes, need Hindi or speaker labels in other languages, or track work in Jira.
notion-note-taker.27: No. Notion AI Meeting Notes is included on the Business plan ($20 per member per month) and Enterprise. Free and Plus plans get only a limited trial. On Plus today? Moving to Business for meeting notes doubles your per-member cost from $10 to $20, so compare it with dedicated tools.
notion-note-taker.28: Open the Notion desktop app, type `/meet` on a page, click Start transcribing when the meeting begins, and click Stop when it ends. Notion writes the summary into the page. It needs at least 1 minute of speech to write a summary, and each user can transcribe up to 10 hours a day.
notion-note-taker.31: Notion is better if your team already uses Notion Business and wants notes inside its workspace. Granola is better as a standalone, cheaper note app with mobile capture on iPhone and Android. Choose Notion if notes should live beside your docs and tasks, or Granola if you want a separate app.
